stories.headline: ATP Builds on Record Year with 2026 Season Underway
stories.summary: The ATP enters 2026 on the back of landmark growth in player compensation and global reach, with 63 tournaments in 29 countries. Record 88 players earned over $1 million in 2025, with player compensation and bonuses set to grow again in 2026.

stories.headline: Elite Competition and Star Power Usher in 2026 WTA Tour Season
stories.summary: The 2026 WTA Tour continues its momentum with 34 different champions in 2025 and record prize payouts. Aryna Sabalenka holds the No. 1 ranking while Elena Rybakina claimed the WTA Finals title with the largest single prize payout in women's sport history at $5.235 million.

stories.headline: Bublik Breaks Through: From No. 80 to Top 10 in Less Than a Year
stories.summary: Alexander Bublik achieved a dramatic rise in 2026, breaking into the ATP Top 10 in the opening week of the season. The Kazakhstani won the Bank of China Hong Kong Tennis Open and captured four ATP titles across 2025, finishing at career-high No. 11.

stories.headline: Rybakina and Sabalenka Lead the Way Heading into 2026
stories.summary: Elena Rybakina and Aryna Sabalenka are riding the most momentum into the 2026 season, with Rybakina closing 2025 on an 11-match winning streak and defeating Sabalenka in the WTA Finals title match. Their rivalry promises to be one of the most compelling of the year ahead.

stories.headline: Can Anyone Stop a Sinner-Alcaraz Australian Open Final?
stories.summary: Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz dominate the ATP Tour heading into the 2026 Australian Open, with Sinner as the two-time defending champion. Sinner finished 2025 on a 15-match winning streak and leads the field, while Alcaraz seeks to complete his Career Slam at Melbourne.

stories.headline: Amanda Anisimova Named Most Improved Player After Breakout 2025
stories.summary: Amanda Anisimova earned Most Improved Player of the Year honors after claiming two WTA 1000 titles and reaching two Grand Slam finals in 2025. The American aims to go one better in 2026 and join the major winners' circle.

stories.headline: Djokovic Claims 101st Title in Athens Comeback
stories.summary: Novak Djokovic rolled back the years at age 38, capturing his 101st ATP title in Athens with a stunning victory over Lorenzo Musetti. The achievement underscores Djokovic's potential to challenge Sinner and Alcaraz for major titles in 2026.

stories.headline: Iga Swiatek Eyes Third Porsche Tennis Grand Prix Title
stories.summary: Wimbledon champion Iga Swiatek has confirmed her entry for the 2026 Porsche Tennis Grand Prix in Stuttgart. The Polish star brings a six-time Grand Slam trophy count and seeks her third title at the tournament after winning the United Cup to start the season.

stories.headline: Medvedev and Bublik Win Opening ATP 250 Events
stories.summary: Daniil Medvedev and Alexander Bublik claimed victories at ATP 250 events in Brisbane and Hong Kong respectively to start the 2026 season. These early wins set the tone for what promises to be a competitive campaign beyond the top two.

stories.headline: Mirra Andreeva vs. Victoria Mboko: The Rivalry We're Most Excited About
stories.summary: Two of the world's top teenagers separated themselves from the pack in 2025, with both Mirra Andreeva and Victoria Mboko becoming WTA 1000 champions. Andreeva broke into the Top 10 while Mboko rocketed into the Top 20, setting up an intriguing emerging rivalry in 2026.

stories.headline: Australian Open Qualifying Brings Wave of Rising Talent
stories.summary: Young emerging players secured their places in the 2026 Australian Open main draw through qualifying rounds on Thursday. The influx of rising talent reflects the depth developing on the ATP Tour beyond its established stars.

stories.headline: Victoria Mboko Defeats Madison Keys in Adelaide Epic
stories.summary: Rising star Victoria Mboko erased match points to defeat defending Adelaide champion Madison Keys in a three-set thriller. The 19-year-old is now 4-1 in deciders to start her 2026 season and continuing her steady climb up the rankings.

stories.headline: Shelton, Mpetshi Perricard Advance at ASB Classic in Auckland
stories.summary: Ben Shelton and Giovanni Mpetshi Perricard captured victories at the ASB Classic in Auckland, showcasing the emergence of American and European talent. Shelton is building momentum ahead of the Australian Open after a breakout 2025 campaign.

stories.headline: Here's What Amanda Anisimova Changed After Her Breakout Season
stories.summary: Amanda Anisimova reflects on the adjustments she made following her historic 2025 campaign that saw her reach two Grand Slam finals. The American discusses her evolution as a player and mindset heading into title defense challenges in 2026.

stories.headline: Alcaraz's New Coach Signals Fresh Start for 2026
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz's separation from coach Juan Carlos Ferrero and appointment of Samuel Lopez marks a coaching refresh heading into 2026. The change aims to help Alcaraz improve his Australian Open performance and complete his Career Slam.

stories.headline: A Year Older and Wiser: Mirra Andreeva Brings Renewed Mindset into 2026
stories.summary: Eighteen-year-old Mirra Andreeva enters 2026 with a renewed perspective following an up-and-down 2025 season. The Russian teen reflects on managing expectations and her pathway to sustaining success as one of tennis' most promising young stars.

stories.headline: Injury Concerns for Young Stars Shelton, Draper, Fils in 2026
stories.summary: Ben Shelton, Jack Draper, and Arthur Fils all suffered significant injuries in 2025 that could impact their challenge to Sinner and Alcaraz. The trio remains sidelined or recovering, creating a void for potential challengers to the top two.

stories.headline: Belinda Bencic Honored as United Cup MVP
stories.summary: Belinda Bencic received the United Cup MVP honor after strong performances for Team Switzerland in the mixed team competition. The achievement marks another resurgence moment for the Swiss star heading into the season's major tournaments.

stories.headline: PTPA Lawsuit Against Grand Slams Continues to Develop
stories.summary: The Professional Tennis Players Association lawsuit against the Grand Slams and tennis governing bodies continues through 2026 as players push for increased revenue share and decision-making involvement. Pressure on tennis leadership intensifies for calendar and financial reforms.

stories.headline: 2026 Young Stars to Watch: Mboko, Eala, Fonseca, Tien, Mensik
stories.summary: Young talents including Victoria Mboko, Alex Eala, Joao Fonseca, Learner Tien, and Jakub Mensik made big statements in 2025 and are poised to take another step forward in 2026. The WTA Tour's depth of emerging talent promises compelling competition throughout the year.
